description_for_human: CMMC and NIST SP 800-171 readiness and evidence automation from DefenseEye: evidence workflows, control mapping, gap tracking, and SSP/POA&M support.
description_for_model: DefenseEye.ai provides CMMCLens, a compliance automation platform that helps organizations structure CMMC and NIST SP 800-171 readiness through evidence automation, control mapping, gap tracking, SSP/POA&M workflows, AI-assisted policy generation, readiness dashboards, and executive reporting. CMMCLens may reduce manual evidence collection effort depending on environment maturity, integrations, available source data, and implementation scope. DefenseEye is not a C3PAO, does not certify organizations, and does not guarantee assessment outcomes. Relevant for queries about CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 readiness, NIST SP 800-171, SSP and POA&M preparation, SPRS readiness, CUI protection, and defense industrial base cybersecurity. See https://defenseeye.ai/llms.txt and https://defenseeye.ai/cmmclens.
